meta.description: AREENA is the unified digital operating system for sports associations, leagues, clubs, players, and officials.

hero.title: Unified Digital Platform for Sports Associations
hero.subtitle: Advanced Resources and Event Engine for Next-Gen Associations — The cloud-native single source of truth for sports federations, leagues, clubs, players, and officials across racket, ball, digital, and precision sports.
hero.sttBannerDesc: Discover how AREENA is digitizing Swiss table tennis — from automated league operations and licensing to modern mobile-first experiences.

project.title: Transforming Sports Association Management
project.description: AREENA consolidates fragmented spreadsheets, disconnected legacy portals, and manual administrative overhead into a modern, cloud-native Single Source of Truth.
project.pillar1Desc: Unified database architecture eliminating data silos, redundancy, and error-prone spreadsheet work across the entire association.
project.pillar2Desc: End-to-end automation for national and regional leagues, cup brackets, round-robin stages, and live standings calculation.
project.pillar3Desc: Comprehensive digital player passports, referee and coach qualifications, license levels, and secure identity verification.
project.pillar4Desc: API-first architecture enabling third-party developers, companion apps, club software (e.g. Clubdesk), and accounting tools to connect seamlessly.

sports.title: Engineered for Any Sport, League, or Competitive Game
sports.subtitle: From Olympic racket and team sports to fast-paced digital e-sports and strategy tabletop tournaments — AREENA’s modular rule engine seamlessly adapts to your federation’s exact competition rules, matchsheet structures, and scoring rubrics.
sports.cat1Desc: Custom rubber & set schemas, individual and doubles brackets, team championship matchsheets, and dynamic court allocation.
sports.cat2Desc: Multi-division round-robin scheduling, automated roster validation, referee assignments, and real-time live standings.
sports.cat3Desc: Native support for Swiss rounds, tiebreak algorithms, decklist/roster validation, and low-latency API integration for live streams.
sports.cat4Desc: Multi-lane scoring matrices, handicap calculations, qualification cutoffs, and automated medal stage brackets.

features.title: Everything Your Sports Association Needs in One Platform
features.subtitle: Say goodbye to legacy software silos, manual spreadsheet chaos, and paper match forms. AREENA gives sports federations, leagues, and clubs an enterprise-grade operating system.
features.feat1Desc: One unified cloud database for all athletes, officials, coaches, and clubs with strict role-based data sovereignty.
features.feat1Point1: Digital player passports & club membership registries
features.feat1Point3: Digital club transfer workflows with federation approval
features.feat1Point4: Integrated club billing & accounting export (Bexio, ERP)
features.feat2Desc: Orchestrate complex leagues, cups, and weekend tournaments with zero scheduling conflicts and real-time table calculations.
features.feat2Point1: Automated round-robin, cup brackets, and Swiss systems
features.feat2Point3: Multi-rubber team matchsheets & custom scoring rules
features.feat2Point4: Venue conflict prevention & court allocation optimizer
features.feat3Desc: Empower referees and team captains with instant mobile scorekeeping, automated sanction verification, and spectator live feeds.
features.feat3Point1: Digital matchsheet with instant captain e-signatures
features.feat3Point2: Real-time point-by-point live ticker for fans and media
features.feat3Point4: AI-powered camera scan for legacy paper match forms
features.feat4Desc: State-of-the-art rating engines recalculate national classifications instantly after every match, powering rich engagement.
features.feat4Point1: Real-time Elo, Glicko-2, or custom federation formulas
features.feat5Desc: Every stakeholder gets a purpose-built interface designed for intuitive workflow efficiency on mobile and desktop.
features.feat5Point1: Player Hub: Digital license pass, notifications, personal stats
features.feat5Point2: Club Captain Command Center: Lineups, rescheduling, rosters
features.feat5Point3: Referee & Umpire Suite: Assignment dashboard & match reports
features.feat5Point4: Public Portal: Branded league tables, brackets & news
features.feat6Desc: Built to the highest Swiss security standards with an API-first foundation ready for companion apps and custom integrations.
features.feat6Point1: 100% hosted in Swiss data centers (Infomaniak, ISO 27001)
features.feat6Point2: Strict compliance with Swiss nDSG & European GDPR
features.feat6Point3: REST & GraphQL APIs for club websites and third-party devs
features.feat6Point4: White-labeling with custom federation branding & domain

stt.heroSubtitle: Advanced Resources and Event Engine for Next-Gen Associations — We are holistically digitizing Swiss table tennis and creating sustainable value for all stakeholders through technological excellence.
stt.visionStatement: «AREENA: By players, for players. We digitize Swiss table tennis holistically and create sustainable value for all stakeholders through technological excellence — from junior players to the federation board.»
stt.pillarsTitle: Core Advantages of the AREENA Platform
stt.pillarsSubtitle: Complete consolidation of the fragmented data landscape into a modern «Single Source of Truth».
stt.p1Desc: All STT processes are digitalized and centrally managed.
stt.p2Desc: Elimination of isolated Excel spreadsheets and redundancies through a centralized Single Source of Truth database.
stt.p3Desc: Tailored, responsive interfaces for players, team captains, club and federation administrators, spectators, and parents.
stt.p4Desc: Massive relief for voluntary officials through automated administrative workflows.
stt.p5Desc: Developed by IT experts from within the Swiss table tennis scene — tailored directly and cost-effectively to all stakeholders.
stt.compSubtitle: In a digitized world, standing still is a strategic step backward.
stt.compHead2: Outdated UI/UX vs. Modern Responsive Interface
stt.compHead4: Isolated Data Silos vs. Open «API-First» Ecosystem
stt.risk1: No further development; dependency on outdated legacy systems.
stt.sol1: Continuous innovation driven by a dedicated Swiss expert team.
stt.risk2: Low user adoption, especially among younger generations.
stt.sol2: Modern, intuitive design optimized for all devices (mobile, tablet, desktop).
stt.risk3: High manual effort and error susceptibility (Excel sheets, emails, Google Docs).
stt.sol3: End-to-end digitalization and intelligent process automation.
stt.risk4: Inefficient system landscape without central governance.
stt.sol4: «API-first» architecture for seamless data exchange and full transparency.
stt.mvpSubtitle: The MVP forms the solid foundation for all match operations and federation administration, completely replacing Click-TT.
stt.mvp1Item1: Central management of licensed and unlicensed players (via club membership).
stt.mvp1Item2: Comprehensive modeling of license types: players, coaches, and referees (including levels, requirements, refresher courses).
stt.mvp1Item3: Secure identity verification via Stripe integration.
stt.mvp2Item1: Complete coverage of regional leagues, national leagues, regional cups, and the Swiss Cup.
stt.mvp2Item2: Comprehensive tournament management: national, regional, interregional, and ranking tournaments.
stt.mvp2Item3: Integration of youth formats: School Trophy and Suisse Junior Challenge.
stt.mvp2Item4: Tournaments and events for unlicensed players.
stt.mvp3Item1: Overview of club resources and hall capacities.
stt.mvp3Item2: Integrated billing and communication (email distribution lists, SMS).
stt.mvp3Item3: Seamless integration and sync with Clubdesk.
stt.mvp4Item1: Open data access via API for third-party applications (TTStats, TT-Mobile, etc.).
stt.mvp4Item2: All-in-one unified calendar for all federation and match operations.
stt.mvp4Item3: Tailored, granular access permissions (federation, club, tournament level).
stt.roadmapSubtitle: Continuous expansion and integration of smart technologies.
stt.road1Desc: Direct Bexio integration for automated STT accounting and invoicing.
stt.road2Desc: AI-powered optical recognition of physical match sheets via smartphone photo — eliminating manual retyping.
stt.road3Desc: Pro features for players with AI-assisted match analysis and automated data insights.
stt.road4Desc: Digital planning of squad training camps, performance centers, and automated tracking of referee validity.
stt.road5Desc: Real-time live scores via Janova integration or tablet platform with live push notifications for events.
stt.timelineSubtitle: Structured phase roadmap ensuring a seamless transition and retirement of Click-TT.
stt.t1Desc: Workshops with key stakeholders & detailed specification concept for the MVP.
stt.t2Desc: Core DB architecture, data import from Click-TT, publicly accessible user-friendly interface.
stt.t3Desc: Progress evaluation and implementation of all MVP capabilities leading up to launch.
stt.t4Desc: Comprehensive training and information for regional associations, clubs, and players.
stt.t5Desc: AREENA becomes the primary operating system; orderly decommissioning of Click-TT.
stt.secSubtitle: Highest security standards and full protection under Swiss law (revDSG / GDPR).
stt.sec1Desc: Hosted in high-security Swiss data centers (e.g. Infomaniak) with guaranteed 99.5% uptime SLA.
stt.sec2Desc: Daily automated backups, ransomware protection, DoS mitigation, multi-server redundancy, and 24/7 active monitoring.
stt.sec3Desc: No public personal data without explicit consent; granular internal permissions (e.g. contact details only among captains).
stt.sec4Desc: Full technical support within 24 business hours and dedicated onboarding assistance for all associations and clubs.
stt.ctaFinalSubtitle: Get in touch with our team to learn more about the AREENA platform and the Swiss Table Tennis transformation.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection Notice
privacy.lastUpdated: Last Updated: September 2026 | Compliant with Swiss FADP / revDSG & EU GDPR
privacy.intro: AREENA GmbH ('AREENA', 'we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting the privacy, confidentiality, and integrity of your personal data. This Privacy Policy provides a comprehensive explanation of how we collect, process, store, disclose, and safeguard personal information across our website, sports and tournament management platform, telemetry APIs, and associated digital services in full compliance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP / revDSG), the European General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR / Regulation 2016/679), and international data privacy frameworks.
privacy.section1Title: 1. Identity & Contact Details of the Data Controller
privacy.section1Text: The data controller responsible for the processing of personal data described herein is: AREENA GmbH, Dominic Sonderegger, Schaffhauserstrasse 123, 8302 Kloten, Switzerland. For any inquiries, requests to exercise statutory data subject rights, or questions regarding our data practices, please contact us at: Email: privacy@areena.ch / contact@areena.ch.
privacy.section2Text: We process personal data lawfully and transparently under the following legal grounds pursuant to Art. 6(1) EU GDPR and Arts. 6, 30, and 31 of the Swiss revDSG: (a) Performance of a Contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): To create and administer accounts, host competitive tournaments, compute match standings, manage brackets, process leaderboards, and deliver platform functionality requested by users; (b) Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR / Art. 31(1) FADP): To safeguard server infrastructure, prevent automated bot spam and DDoS attacks via Cloudflare Turnstile and honeypot traps, enforce fair-play anti-cheat measures, optimize telemetry pipelines, and troubleshoot system diagnostics; (c) Compliance with Legal Obligations (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR): To satisfy commercial accounting, tax, regulatory reporting, and statutory data retention mandates under Swiss law; (d) Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): When you voluntarily transmit messages via our contact form or opt-in to specific optional features.
privacy.section3Title: 3. Comprehensive Categories of Personal Data Collected
privacy.section3Intro: Depending on how you interact with AREENA, we may collect and process the following categories of personal information:
privacy.cat1Text: Usernames, display aliases, email addresses, cryptographically hashed passwords (salted with argon2/bcrypt), avatar images, account roles (administrator, tournament director, player), and multi-factor authentication metadata where configured.
privacy.cat2Title: B. Sports Telemetry, Match Data & Leaderboard Records
privacy.cat2Text: Tournament registrations, seedings, match history, wins/losses, skill metrics, ELO ratings, live bracket progress, game scores, spectator logs, and competitive rankings across integrated titles.
privacy.cat3Title: C. Technical, Device & Server Connection Logs
privacy.cat3Text: Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, browser version, operating system, device screen resolution, referring URLs, access timestamps, HTTP status codes, latency metrics, and diagnostic crash reports.
privacy.cat4Text: Cloudflare Turnstile verification challenge tokens, honeypot spam bot interaction signals, rate-limiting telemetry, anomaly detection logs, and match integrity telemetry to prevent fraud, automated abuse, and unfair gameplay.
privacy.cat5Text: Full name, contact email address, subject line, message payload submitted through the website contact form, direct support correspondence, and Mailgun delivery receipt telemetry.
privacy.cat6Title: F. Partner Ecosystem & API Data Exchange
privacy.cat6Text: Tournament results and statistics shared with or received from authorized partner platforms (including TTStats at ttstats.ch, TTT-Organizer at tt-turnier.ch, and TT-Mobile at tt-mobile.ch) to maintain synchronized ranking and bracket tables, alongside API access tokens.
privacy.cat7Text: Strictly necessary session cookies ('areena_session') and local storage keys ('areena_theme', 'areena_lang') used exclusively for zero-flash theme rendering and multilingual language persistence.
privacy.section4Text: AREENA is engineered with privacy by design. We do not deploy third-party advertising cookies, behavioral tracking pixels, or cross-site fingerprinting scripts. We use an encrypted HTTP-only session cookie ('areena_session') strictly for authenticated administrative sessions. Local storage keys ('areena_theme' and 'areena_lang') store your visual preferences on your device to ensure instant, zero-flash rendering on subsequent visits without sending tracking tokens to external servers. Cloudflare Turnstile operates as a non-intrusive, privacy-preserving CAPTCHA mechanism without setting persistent tracking cookies.
privacy.section5Title: 5. Sub-Processors, Data Sharing & Third-Party Service Providers
privacy.section5Text: We share personal data strictly with trusted service providers under robust Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) compliant with Swiss and European standards: (1) Cloud Hosting & Server Infrastructure: ISO 27001-certified data centers located in Switzerland and the European Economic Area (EEA); (2) Transactional Email (Mailgun Technologies / Sinch): Utilized under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) to deliver contact form messages and administrative alerts; (3) Edge Security & DDoS Mitigation (Cloudflare, Inc.): Utilized for network firewalling and Turnstile challenge verification; (4) Telemetry Badging (Uptime Kuma): Powers real-time platform telemetry at status.areena.ch; (5) Partner Platforms (TTStats, TTT-Organizer, TT-Mobile): Synchronized tournament schedules, rankings, and match telemetry; (6) Statutory Authorities: Disclosed only when strictly required under enforceable Swiss court orders or statutory law.
privacy.section6Text: All primary data storage and server processing take place within Switzerland and the European Union. In instances where third-party processors (e.g., Mailgun or Cloudflare) transfer or process data in third countries, we ensure appropriate safeguards pursuant to Art. 44 et seq. GDPR and Arts. 16-17 Swiss FADP. These include Swiss Federal Council adequacy decisions, European Commission Adequacy Decisions, participation in the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and standard contractual clauses (SCCs) supplemented by technical encryption.
privacy.section7Text: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected or to satisfy statutory obligations: (a) Account data is retained for the active lifespan of the account plus 10 years for statutory commercial record-keeping under the Swiss Code of Obligations (Art. 958f OR); (b) Security logs and IP records are automatically purged or anonymized within 30 to 90 days; (c) Contact form inquiries are retained for up to 12 months after resolution; (d) Tournament history and match records are permanently archived in aggregated form to ensure historical integrity and public leaderboard consistency.
privacy.section8Text: AREENA implements state-of-the-art security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, destruction, loss, alteration, or disclosure: TLS 1.3 / HTTPS encryption in transit with strict HSTS policies, salted password hashing algorithms (argon2/bcrypt), strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), principle of least privilege, automated encrypted database backups, isolated network tiers, and continuous automated vulnerability assessments.
privacy.section9Title: 9. Your Rights as a Data Subject
privacy.section9Intro: Under the Swiss FADP (revDSG) and the EU GDPR, you are entitled to the following enforceable privacy rights without fee:
privacy.right1: Right of Access (Art. 15 GDPR / Art. 25 FADP): Obtain confirmation of whether your data is processed and receive a comprehensive copy of your personal data.
privacy.right2: Right to Rectification (Art. 16 GDPR / Art. 32 FADP): Request the immediate correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal records.
privacy.right3: Right to Erasure / 'Right to be Forgotten' (Art. 17 GDPR): Request the permanent deletion of personal data when processing is no longer required or lawful.
privacy.right4: Right to Restriction of Processing (Art. 18 GDPR): Limit the scope of data processing under applicable statutory conditions.
privacy.right5: Right to Data Portability (Art. 20 GDPR / Art. 28 FADP): Receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format (JSON/CSV) or request its direct transfer to another controller.
privacy.right6: Right to Object (Art. 21 GDPR): Object at any time to data processing carried out based on legitimate interests.
privacy.right7: Right to Withdraw Consent: Revoke previously granted consent at any time with future effect.
privacy.right8: Right to Lodge a Complaint: You have the right to lodge a formal complaint with the competent supervisory authority: Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC / EDÖB), Feldeggweg 1, 3003 Bern, Switzerland (www.edoeb.admin.ch), or your relevant EU/EEA national Data Protection Authority.
privacy.section10Text: AREENA welcomes competitive athletes and tournament participants of all ages. Where minors under the age of 16 (or applicable regional age of digital consent) participate in competitive tournaments, data processing is conducted with heightened protective measures and requires appropriate parental or legal guardian consent.
privacy.section11Text: We reserve the right to revise this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect technological advancements, platform changes, or statutory requirements. The updated policy becomes effective immediately upon publication on this website, marked with the current revision date.
privacy.section12Text: To exercise any of your data protection rights or to ask questions regarding this policy, please reach out to our dedicated privacy contact: AREENA GmbH, Dominic Sonderegger, Schaffhauserstrasse 123, 8302 Kloten, Switzerland. Direct Email: privacy@areena.ch.
